instructions.name: add_to_collection
docs: Move a Core asset the payer controls into one of their collections.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Update authority of the asset and authority of the destination collection.

accounts.name: current_collection
docs: mpl-core validates it against the asset's update authority.

accounts.name: new_collection
docs: payer's authority over it.

instructions.name: bid
docs: Bid on a Dutch auction at the current descending price (price-capped).

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy tokens along the curve with SOL (slippage-guarded).

accounts.name: perk
docs: Optional perk NFT owned by the buyer; grants a trading-fee discount.
Constrained to a perk PDA owned by the buyer when supplied.

instructions.name: buy_conviction
docs: Buy on a conviction curve; re-locks the holder's position.

instructions.name: buy_nft
docs: Buy the 1-of-1 NFT at the current descending price; transfers it to the buyer.

instructions.name: buy_revenue
docs: Buy revenue shares at the fixed launch price; auto-stakes for revenue.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: purchase payment + fee (creator-raise routing is a later refinement).

instructions.name: claim_creator_fee
docs: Claim a token's accrued creator fees — gated on the creator being
SAS-verified (they must hold a `Verification` record).

accounts.name: verification
docs: The creator's SAS verification record. Its existence at this PDA gates the
claim — an unverified creator cannot construct a valid transaction, which
is exactly the brief's "claimable by the X account owner once they verify".

instructions.name: claim_genesis_fee
docs: Claim a genesis NFT holder's accrued share of the token's fees.

instructions.name: claim_revenue
docs: Claim a shareholder's accrued revenue.

instructions.name: create_collection
docs: Create a Core collection whose update authority stays with the payer.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The new Core collection (client-generated keypair, signs its creation).

instructions.name: deposit_genesis_fee
docs: Route a token's fees to its genesis NFT holders (split pro-rata by share).

instructions.name: deposit_revenue
docs: Deposit revenue to be split pro-rata across current shareholders.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Migrate a graduated curve's liquidity into a native AMM pool (permissionless).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless: anyone can trigger migration once the curve is complete.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the one-time protocol config (fees, treasury, curve defaults).

accounts.name: treasury
docs: never be routed into a program-controlled account.

instructions.name: launch_conviction
docs: Launch a token on a conviction curve: constant-product pricing plus a
loyalty time-lock and early-exit penalty (for niche/community verticals).

instructions.name: launch_from_feed
docs: Launch a bonding-curve token seeded from a Switchboard mindshare feed
(decentralized oracle) instead of a trusted keeper tier argument.

accounts.name: feed
docs: Switchboard program) is checked in the handler, then parsed +
staleness-validated — a single `owner =` constraint can't accept either
cluster's program id.

instructions.name: launch_revenue
docs: Launch a revenue-share token: shares are a pro-rata claim on deposited
revenue (the creator-economy mechanism).

instructions.name: launch_token
docs: Launch a new token: mint the supply into a curve-owned vault and seed the
bonding curve's starting price from the subject's mindshare tier.

accounts.name: mint
docs: New SPL mint for the token (client-generated keypair, signs creation).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Curve-owned vault that holds the full token supply for sale.

instructions.name: level_up
docs: Level up a perk NFT: rewrites its on-chain Attributes and raises its fee
discount (program-controlled via the perk authority PDA).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Protocol keeper triggering the level-up (e.g. on volume milestones).

accounts.name: perk_authority
docs: update via seeds. Validated by seeds.

instructions.name: mint_genesis
docs: Mint a transferable fee-share genesis NFT (Metaplex Core) for a token,
carrying a `share_bps` claim on its fee stream.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The subject token's creator, issuing genesis fee-share NFTs for it.

accounts.name: curve
docs: The subject token's bonding curve — gates issuance to its creator.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Core asset (client-generated keypair, signs its creation).

instructions.name: mint_nft
docs: Mint a plain Core NFT (collectible with an optional image), standalone
or straight into one of the payer's collections.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Core asset (client-generated keypair, signs its creation).

accounts.name: collection
docs: the payer holds its update authority.

instructions.name: mint_perk
docs: Mint an upgradeable perk NFT (Metaplex Core) granting platform fee
discounts; starts at level 1.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Protocol keeper minting the perk to a participant.

accounts.name: perk_authority
docs: program-controlled level-ups). Validated by seeds.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Core asset (client-generated keypair, signs its creation).

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell tokens back into the curve for SOL (slippage-guarded).

accounts.name: perk
docs: Optional perk NFT owned by the seller; grants a trading-fee discount.

instructions.name: sell_conviction
docs: Sell on a conviction curve; forfeits the early-exit penalty if still locked.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: early-exit penalty (LP-reward proxy until real LP distribution ships).

instructions.name: set_issuer
docs: Set or rotate the dedicated key authorized to sign SAS attestations
(admin-gated by `Global.authority`).

instructions.name: settle_auction
docs: Finalize a Dutch auction once it has ended.

instructions.name: start_auction
docs: Launch a token as a Dutch auction: price descends from `start_price` to
`floor_price` over `duration` seconds (fair launch for narrative tokens).

accounts.name: mint
docs: New SPL mint (client-generated keypair, signs creation).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Auction-owned vault holding the full allocation for sale.

instructions.name: start_nft_auction
docs: Start a Dutch auction for a 1-of-1 Core NFT (escrowed under the auction PDA).

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new 1-of-1 Core asset (client-generated keypair, signs its creation).

instructions.name: swap
docs: Swap on a graduated token's AMM pool. `is_buy` = SOL in / tokens out.

instructions.name: update_mindshare
docs: Refresh a token's on-chain mindshare snapshot from the Switchboard feed
(permissionless crank; the value is trusted from the oracle, not the caller).

accounts.name: feed
docs: in the handler via `read_mindshare_bps`.

instructions.name: verify_handle
docs: Verify an X handle↔wallet binding against a Solana Attestation Service
attestation and mint a soulbound verification NFT (Metaplex Core).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for the credential accounts. Can be anyone (subject or a relayer) —
trust comes from the attestation, not from who submits the transaction.

accounts.name: issuer_config
docs: The dedicated attestation issuer, if one has been configured via
`set_issuer`. Absent (pre-migration) falls back to `global.authority`.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: validated in the handler.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Core asset (client-generated keypair, signs its own creation).

errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Slippage tolerance exceeded

errors.name: CurveComplete

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: InsufficientReserves

errors.name: InvalidAuctionParams
errors.msg: Invalid auction parameters

errors.name: AuctionEnded

errors.name: AuctionNotEnded

errors.name: SoldOut

errors.name: PriceAboveMax
errors.msg: Current price exceeds the bidder's maximum

errors.name: InsufficientPosition
errors.msg: Position holds fewer tokens than requested

errors.name: NoStakers

errors.name: InsufficientShares

errors.name: Unauthorized

errors.name: InvalidHandle

errors.name: MaxLevelReached

errors.name: InvalidAttestation

errors.name: AttestationExpired

errors.name: InvalidTreasury

errors.name: InvalidFeed

errors.name: StaleFeed

errors.name: NoCreatorFees

errors.name: NotReadyToGraduate
errors.msg: Curve has not reached the graduation threshold

errors.name: InsufficientActivity
errors.msg: Not enough trading volume or deposits to reach the next perk level

types.name: AmmPool
docs: Native constant-product AMM pool created when a bonding curve graduates.
Holds the migrated real SOL + remaining tokens; trades `x*y=k`. One PDA per mint.

fields.name: sol_reserves
docs: Real SOL in the pool (lamports held in this account, above rent).

fields.name: token_reserves
docs: Tokens in the pool vault.

types.name: AmmSwapEvent
docs: Emitted on every AMM swap.

types.name: BondingCurve
docs: Per-token bonding curve. One PDA per mint, seeded by mindshare tier.

fields.name: virtual_sol_reserves
docs: Virtual SOL reserves (seeded from the mindshare tier).

fields.name: virtual_token_reserves
docs: Virtual token reserves.

fields.name: real_sol_reserves
docs: Real SOL actually deposited into the curve.

fields.name: real_token_reserves
docs: Real tokens still held in the curve vault.

fields.name: token_total_supply
docs: Total supply minted for this token.

fields.name: creator_fees
docs: Creator fees accrued (lamports held in this account, claimable once verified).

fields.name: tier
docs: Mindshare tier this curve was seeded at.

fields.name: complete
docs: True once the curve has hit the graduation threshold.

types.name: ConvictionCurve
docs: Per-token conviction curve. Prices identically to the bonding curve
(constant-product virtual reserves) but every buy time-locks the holder and
early sells forfeit a penalty. One PDA per mint.

fields.name: lock_period
docs: Seconds a position is locked after each buy.

fields.name: early_exit_penalty_bps
docs: Penalty (bps) applied to proceeds when selling before unlock.

types.name: ConvictionPosition
docs: A holder's stake in a conviction curve. Seeded per (mint, owner). Each buy
re-locks the whole position until `unlock_time`.

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units currently held under this position.

fields.name: unlock_time
docs: Unix time at which the position unlocks (penalty-free selling).

types.name: CreatorClaimEvent
docs: Emitted when a verified creator claims accrued creator fees.

types.name: DutchAuction
docs: Per-token Dutch auction. One PDA per mint. Price descends linearly from
`start_price` to `floor_price` over `duration` seconds; bidders pay the
current price, so buying early costs more (fair launch, no front-running edge).

fields.name: start_price
docs: Ceiling price, lamports per whole token.

fields.name: floor_price
docs: Floor price, lamports per whole token.

fields.name: start_time
docs: Auction start (unix seconds).

fields.name: duration
docs: Auction length in seconds.

fields.name: total_for_sale
docs: Total base units offered for sale.

fields.name: tokens_sold
docs: Base units sold so far.

fields.name: real_sol_reserves
docs: Lamports of proceeds collected.

fields.name: tier
docs: Mindshare tier this auction was tagged at.

fields.name: complete
docs: True once sold out or settled after end.

types.name: GenesisNft
docs: A fee-share genesis NFT: a transferable Metaplex Core asset minted to an
early participant of a specific token, carrying a `share_bps` claim on that
token's fee stream. One PDA per asset. (Claim routing wires up during the
fee-distribution pass.)

fields.name: asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset backing this genesis share.

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner at mint time.

fields.name: subject_mint
docs: The token whose fee stream this NFT shares.

fields.name: share_bps
docs: Fraction of the token's fee stream, in basis points.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Accumulator snapshot (`accrued(share_bps, acc)`) at last settle.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Settled-but-unclaimed fees.

types.name: GenesisPool
docs: Per-token pool of genesis fees, split pro-rata across that token's genesis
NFTs by `share_bps`. One PDA per subject mint.

fields.name: total_share_bps
docs: Sum of `share_bps` across the token's minted genesis NFTs.

fields.name: acc_per_share
docs: Cumulative fee per share-bps, scaled by `revenue::ACC_SCALE`.

fields.name: reserves
docs: Lamports of deposited fees still available to claim.

types.name: Global
docs: Protocol-wide configuration, created once at `initialize`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin authority (may update config in later phases).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination for trading fees.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Curve trading fee in basis points.

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Creator's share of each trading fee, in bps of the fee.

fields.name: graduation_sol
docs: Real SOL raised at which a curve graduates.

fields.name: virtual_token_reserves
docs: Default virtual token reserves seeded into new curves.

fields.name: token_total_supply
docs: Total supply minted per launched token.

fields.name: token_decimals
docs: SPL mint decimals for launched tokens.

fields.name: tokens_launched
docs: Number of tokens launched through the program.

types.name: GraduateEvent
docs: Emitted once, when a curve crosses the graduation threshold.

types.name: IssuerConfig
docs: The dedicated key authorized to sign SAS attestations for `verify_handle`,
separate from `Global.authority` so the attestation issuer (a hot key held
by the `/api/verify` service) can rotate without touching the protocol's
admin key. Singleton PDA; absent until `set_issuer` is called for the
first time, in which case `verify_handle` still trusts `Global.authority`.

types.name: LaunchEvent
docs: Emitted when a new token is launched under any mechanism.

fields.name: mechanism
docs: One of the `MECH_*` discriminants.

types.name: MindshareState
docs: On-chain snapshot of a token's mindshare, sourced from the Switchboard feed.
Keyed by mint (works for any launch mechanism) and kept fresh by an
oracle-gated `update_mindshare` crank. Instructions that want to react to
attention (dynamic graduation, mindshare-weighted rewards) read this cheaply
instead of requiring a fresh oracle read in their own transaction. Separate
from the curve accounts so adding it never changes their layout.

fields.name: mindshare_bps
docs: Conversation share in basis points (e.g. 3.24% => 324).

fields.name: tier
docs: Tier derived from `mindshare_bps` at the last update.

fields.name: updated_slot
docs: Slot of the last oracle update (freshness for readers).

types.name: MindshareTier
docs: Mindshare rank tier supplied by the (trusted, off-chain) launch keeper.
Determines the curve's starting virtual SOL reserve.

types.name: NftAuction
docs: A Dutch auction for a single 1-of-1 Metaplex Core NFT (art/music verticals).
The asset is escrowed under this PDA (which owns it) until sold; price
descends from `start_price` to `floor_price`. One PDA per asset.

fields.name: asset
docs: The 1-of-1 Core asset being sold.

fields.name: creator
docs: Seller who receives the proceeds.

fields.name: start_price
docs: Ceiling price in lamports (absolute, for the single NFT).

fields.name: floor_price
docs: Floor price in lamports.

types.name: PerkNft
docs: An upgradeable perk NFT record. The Metaplex Core asset's Attributes carry
the level/discount for display; this PDA is the on-chain source of truth that
trading instructions read to apply the holder's fee discount. One per asset.

fields.name: asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset backing this perk.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet the perk was minted to.

fields.name: level
docs: Current level (1..=MAX_PERK_LEVEL).

fields.name: discount_bps
docs: Trading-fee discount granted, in basis points.

types.name: PoolCreatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a graduated curve's liquidity migrates into a native AMM pool.

types.name: RevenueShare
docs: Per-token revenue-share pool. Shares are sold at a fixed `share_price` and
entitle the holder to a pro-rata cut of deposited revenue, tracked with a
cumulative `acc_revenue_per_share` accumulator. One PDA per mint.

fields.name: share_price
docs: Fixed acquisition price, lamports per whole token.

fields.name: shares_sold
docs: Shares sold (== total staked, since buying auto-stakes).

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Total shares currently entitled to revenue.

fields.name: acc_revenue_per_share
docs: Cumulative revenue per share, scaled by `revenue::ACC_SCALE`.

fields.name: revenue_reserves
docs: Lamports of deposited revenue still available to claim.

types.name: RevenueStake
docs: A holder's revenue-share stake. Seeded per (mint, owner).

fields.name: staked_amount
docs: Shares held (base units).

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Accumulator snapshot: `accrued(staked, acc)` at last settle.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Settled-but-unclaimed revenue (banked when stake changes).

types.name: TradeEvent
docs: Emitted on every curve trade (buy or sell).

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Gross SOL spent (buy) or net SOL received (sell), in lamports.

fields.name: token_amount
docs: Tokens received (buy) or returned (sell), in base units.

types.name: Verification
docs: On-chain record binding a verified X handle to a wallet and its soulbound
credential NFT. One PDA per subject wallet. The authoritative "this handle is
really this wallet" state; the Metaplex Core asset is the user-visible badge.

fields.name: subject
docs: The verified wallet.

fields.name: asset
docs: The soulbound Metaplex Core asset minted as the credential.

fields.name: handle
docs: The X handle (without leading @).
